reason: I'd happily take the free 15-company list and the local-language message, then run it myself with Apollo and a junior SDR. I've done this kind of outreach before and EUR 300 a meeting looks steep when a whole month of a junior in Sofia costs about the same as a few meetings.
objection: The only proof is one logistics client. I sell manufactured goods for export, and I doubt an agency can talk about my product well enough that the meetings turn into real quote requests, not just polite calls.
would_change_my_mind: A named manufacturing or export client in my kind of market who got meetings that turned into quotes, plus seeing that the free 15 companies are ones I couldn't have found myself in an afternoon on Apollo.
